text.en: Dog owners highly commend trainer Donna for her patience, deep behavioural knowledge, and practical coaching. Reviewers appreciate that sessions provide clear guidance and ongoing encouragement. Clients note that Donna tailors advice to the specific needs of each household rather than offering generic instructions.

Clients report noticeable behavioural improvements within a short timeframe, even for dogs with severe anxiety or reactivity issues. Families who recently adopted rescue dogs emphasize that targeted exercises helped resolve inter-dog tension and walking difficulties. Owners feel equipped to maintain long-term results.

Reviewers emphasize Donnas gentle and consent-based training techniques, highlighting how comfortable nervous dogs feel during sessions. Pet parents appreciate that games and interactive toys are used to build trust naturally. Dogs with traumatic backgrounds or fear of unfamiliar people show substantial confidence gains.

q.en: Does Clever Pets Ireland offer remote consultation options?

a.en: Yes, clients report completing effective video consultations alongside follow-up support to address behavioural concerns.

q.en: Can the trainer assist with newly rehomed or adopted rescue dogs?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviewers highlight successful rehabilitation sessions for newly adopted dogs dealing with stress and socialization challenges.

q.en: What training philosophy is used at Clever Pets Ireland?

a.en: The practice relies on positive reinforcement and individualized, force-free behavioural modification programs.

q.en: Where are in-person training services based?

a.en: Services are based at Meadow View House in Ballyboughal, located in North County Dublin.
